rationale: Declare the HPO and Open Targets readers in their asset layouts, then add RemoteSourcePlanner and RemoteSourceExecutor. One fetch step per asset verifies the release files against the manifest digests, decodes only the missing tables and checks each table's row count; the framework's source steps wait for that fetch. The cache stays authoritative, so a normal build downloads nothing.
subject: pharos_kg/asset/hpo.py and pharos_kg/asset/opentargets.py
title: Give HPO and Open Targets declared source steps
